meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 12-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (orchestrator manual QA plus one gate reviewer) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你发布npm包前想要多智能体全面审查
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes before publishing to npm
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're publishing an npm package and want an AI review before release

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求做发布前评审,Claude 会先跑 /get-unpublished-changes 找出上次 npm 发布以来的改动,按模块分成最多 10 组,每组派一个 ultrabrain 代理深挖,再跑 /review-work 做整体评审,最后用 1 个 oracle 汇总结论:版本号建议、破坏性变更、风险等级(SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY/BLOCK)。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求发布前评审时才触发;普通发布请求不触发,那种情况 /publish 直接发布。像“pre-publish review”、“review before publish”等说法会触发。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a pre-publish review, Claude runs /get-unpublished-changes, splits changes into up to 10 groups each reviewed by an ultrabrain agent, runs /review-work for holistic review, and 1 oracle for release synthesis: version bump, breaking changes, risk level.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review, such as "pre-publish review" or "release review"; a plain publish request does not trigger it — /publish ships directly.

say_en.note: Runs the three phases and reports risk level plus version bump
